lines.text: زمستان گردد و ثابت ثور و اسد و عقرب و دلو است و ثابت از بهر ان خوانند که زمانه
lines.en: becomes winter. And the fixed (signs) are Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, and Aquarius. And they call them fixed because the season

lines.text: را بر آن حال بدارد و جوزا و سنبله و قوس و حوت ذو جسدین اند و از بهر آن
lines.en: keeps it in that state. And Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces are bicorporeal. And because of that

lines.text: اینها را ذو جسدین خوانند که یک نیمه از جوزا ببهارست و دیگر نیمه از تابستان
lines.en: they call them bicorporeal, because one half of Gemini is in spring and the other half is in summer.

lines.text: و یک نیمه از سنبله بتابستانست و یکنیمه خزان باقی بر این قیاس کند و معنی ذو
lines.en: And one half of Virgo is in summer and one half is autumn. The rest is deduced by this analogy. And the meaning of bicorporeal

lines.text: الجسدین حاصل شود والله اعلم بالصواب باب هفتم در درجات بروج ذوات
lines.en: is obtained. And God knows best what is right. Chapter Seven: On the degrees of the signs possessing

lines.text: الظل و مضیئه و خالیه و مظلمه هر که که درجه طالع مضیئه باشد یا نیره دلیل بر روشنی
lines.en: shadow, and luminous, and empty, and dark. Whoever has a luminous or bright ascendant degree, it is an indication of brightness

lines.text: و جمعیت و درجات مظلمه بد بود ذوات قتمه با خالیه دلیل بدی اندک باشد چنانکه
lines.en: and gathering. And dark degrees are bad. Those possessing gloom or empty are an indication of a little badness, as

lines.text: ثبت کردیم
lines.en: we have recorded.

summary.headline: Luminous and Dark Degrees
summary.text: Discussion of fixed and bicorporeal zodiac signs, followed by Chapter Seven’s classification of sign degrees as shadowed, luminous, empty, or dark, with their astrological indications and a table for Aries through Pisces.
